result_text:
The region overview now lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, and oldest first within each priority. I changed one SQL query in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`:

- **`listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion`** (around line 10021): the `ORDER BY` now uses the same priority `CASE` expression as `listOpenSupportTicketsBySalesRep`, followed by `opened_date, id`. I also updated its Javadoc to describe the new order.

The only caller is `RegionManagerService.overviewFor`, so nothing else changes. Closed tickets and other regions are still filtered out as before.

`RegionManagerTest`, `SupportTicketTest`, `DashboardTest` and `RegionReportTest` pass offline. I did not add a test that checks the exact order from your T-1 to T-5 example, so that case is covered by reading the query rather than by a test. Nothing is committed.
